subject: Physics
axis_note: This is an explicit-demand extension matrix. Its only rung is intentionally non-default so ordinary Grade-9 NLM owner-estimate routing cannot enter it; a real mapped question or explicit owner entry must activate the slice.

must_contain: One declared inertial frame and positive ejection direction.
Momentum change per item as final minus initial, not final momentum alone.
A finite-count reconstruction of momentum transferred per unit time before the compact rate formula.
Separate signs for force on ejecta, recoil on launcher and holding force.
A unit check reducing rate times momentum to newtons.

controlled_variation.vary: the item entry velocity while holding mass, exit velocity and ejection rate fixed
controlled_variation.hold: the same inertial frame and positive direction
controlled_variation.notice: the force changes with Delta p_item = m(v_out-v_in), so final momentum alone is not the invariant demand

controlled_variation.vary: the ejection rate while holding the per-item momentum change fixed
controlled_variation.hold: the same item mass and velocity change
controlled_variation.notice: the average force scales directly with items per second
all signed momentum and force values reverse consistently while magnitudes remain unchanged

family.invariant_demand: Choose a frame/direction, determine the momentum change of one fixed-mass ejected item, convert repeated item changes into momentum transferred per unit time, and distinguish the force on ejecta from launcher recoil and a balancing holding force.
family.difficult_move: Keeping one system/body and sign convention through three related but different quantities: per-item momentum change, stream momentum-transfer rate, and the opposite launcher/holding-force directions.
family.independent_check: Verify newton units, reverse the chosen axis and recover sign consistency, and test the zero-transfer boundary v_out=v_in.

support_ladder.handed_over: The sign convention, per-item momentum relation and finite-interval count structure are supplied; the learner completes the rate and reaction directions.
The sign convention and item states are supplied; the learner must construct Delta p_item and convert a repeated count into force.
Only the ejection story, item mass/velocities and rate are supplied; the learner must choose frame, representation, rate relation and force directions independently.

transfer.changed_demand: A recoil/holding-force story supplies mass, launch velocities and number fired per second without naming momentum transfer.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: that the demanded force comes from repeated per-item momentum changes per unit time rather than constant-mass F = m a alone

transfer.changed_demand: The firing rate is given as n items during an interval Delta t instead of directly as items per second.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: the conversion R=n/Delta t and the finite-interval derivation of F_avg=(n/Delta t)Delta p_item

transfer.changed_demand: The discrete momentum-transfer stream is a spray, pellets or parcels rather than bullets.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: that the same bounded repeated-item structure applies while collision and rocket methods remain unnecessary
